# Less Annoying CRM Reviews & Product Details

Visit Website

A CRM without all the nonsense.

Less Annoying CRM is for you if you’ve ever wished you could attach a to-do list to a contact, keep all your notes and emails for a client in one place, or just get a simple nudge so a follow-up never slips through the cracks again

We built Less Annoying CRM in 2009 for the thousands of independent consultants, agents, and small business owners who are hitting the limits of their spreadsheets, but nowhere near needing the complexity of big CRMs.

We're the middle ground between the spreadsheet you're manually updating, and all those complicated, expensive, overwhelming CRMs on top 10 lists. We're built to be more than a spreadsheet, less than a CRM.

You get a simple contact list, a calendar that syncs with Google and Outlook, built-in HIPAA-compliance, and an easy-to-read report of your leads and tasks. All your team members can collaborate without the chaos of a shared spreadsheet, and you'll get a daily email agenda of everything on your plate. What you \*won’t\* get are confusing features you’ll never use, a consultant to set it all up, or a surprise bill because you needed an extra feature.

We believe in one simple price ($15/month/user), no long-term contracts, and free phone and email support from real, happy humans.

See why we are ranked G2's #1 easiest-to-use CRM. Start your no-hassle, 30-day free trial today -- no credit card needed.

"Where have you been all my life?!"

5/5

What do you like best about Less Annoying CRM?

It is incredibly easy to use and impressively responsive. I spent ages trying free trials of CRM systems and I did not warm to any of them until I tried Less Annoying CRM. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Less Annoying CRM?

It is a minor dislike as I accept the company needs to make an income. However, I have 2 members of staff (including me) that are the main users, and two junior members of staff (my two sons who are still at school) who do a couple of hours of work each weekend to help me. I cannot justify or afford the monthly fee for 2 more licenses. If there was some sort of pay-as-you-go accumulator fee for such users, where their total time logged in and being active was added up each month, they'd be able to help me. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Less Annoying CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

For me the software eases the pain of tracking potential new customers. My company is very much in the early stages of contacting as many potential clients as possible. The trough we are trying to get our noses into is enormous, and this means sending letters out to hundreds of companies. The way Less Annoying CRM organises the Companies and Contacts works perfectly for me. It is so easy to use and incredibly responsive. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

"Managing Nutrition Follow-ups and Daily Tasks More Professionally"

5/5

What do you like best about Less Annoying CRM?

It keeps daily healthcare and wellness related work more properly organized without making the system feel complicated. I work as a Dietician & Nutritionist and also create health education content for social media, so I regularly use it for nutrition consultation follow-ups, lifestyle assessment reminders, wellness activity tracking, preventive care scheduling, and healthcare related task management. Creating tasks, managing follow up schedules, checking calendar activities, and organizing consultation reminders feels comfortable during busy work routines. Features like task reports, activity tracking, contact management, calendar scheduling, notes, and reminder organization help me keep different wellness and healthcare workflows more properly arranged from one place instead of managing everything separately.

I also like that handling multiple consultation tasks together does not feel confusing even during longer work schedules. Managing patient follow-ups, preventive wellness reviews, nutrition routine tracking, and health education content planning becomes easier because the workflow feels simple and properly structured. The CRM also performs smoothly while updating tasks, reviewing scheduled activities, checking reports, and managing regular follow-up work.

Another useful thing for me is that the system keeps tasks, reminders, follow-up tracking, calendar workflow, and activity organization connected together in one place, which helps while handling both healthcare consultation work and wellness content planning side by side. Overall, Less Annoying CRM fits naturally into my daily professional workflow and helps me keep healthcare and wellness management activities more properly organized. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about Less Annoying CRM?

While managing many follow-up tasks and activities together, I sometimes feel that the dashboard could show more information on one screen without opening separate sections repeatedly during busy work schedules. but some customization options for layout and workflow organization are a little limited compared to larger CRM systems. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is Less Annoying CRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

Less Annoying CRM is helping me keep healthcare follow-ups, wellness activities, consultation reminders, and daily task management more organized during regular work. Earlier, managing nutrition consultation schedules, lifestyle assessment follow-ups, and health education related activities separately used to become difficult during busy days.

Now it is much easier to manage follow-up tasks, scheduled activities, reminders, notes, and calendar workflow from one place. It also helps me keep preventive wellness reviews, nutrition routine tracking, and healthcare related activities more properly arranged instead of checking everything manually from different places.

Another benefit for me is that handling multiple consultation tasks together feels less confusing because task reports, reminders, and activity tracking stay connected in one workflow. Overall, Less Annoying CRM helps me save time and keeps healthcare and wellness management activities more structured and easier to track during daily work. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.
